import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] comb = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] gainA = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] gainB = new long[32][32];
    static int R, C, N;
    static String pattern;
    static long total;
    static long minDelta;
    static long result;
    static ArrayList<long[]>[] leftPaths = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static ArrayList<long[]>[] rightPaths = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static long[][] pathCount = new long[32][32];

    static void buildPaths(int x, int y, long sum, long w1, long w2, boolean rev) {
        if (x + y == N) {
            leftPaths[x][rev ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{sum, w1});
            if (w2 != 0) {
                rightPaths[x][rev ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{sum, w2});
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x < N) {
            buildPaths(x + 1, y, sum + (!rev ? gainA[x + 1][y] : 0), w1, (pattern.charAt(x + y) != 'B' ? w2 : 0), rev);
        }
        if (y < N) {
            buildPaths(x, y + 1, sum + (rev ? gainB[x][y + 1] : 0), w1, (pattern.charAt(x + y) != 'A' ? w2 : 0), rev);
        }
    }

    static void forwardScan(int x, int y, long acc, boolean rev) {
        if (x + y == N) {
            if (leftPaths[x][rev ? 1 : 0].isEmpty()) return;
            long target = (total + 1) / 2 - acc;
            ArrayList<long[]> list = leftPaths[x][rev ? 1 : 0];
            int idx = lowerBound(list, target);
            if (idx < list.size() && list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                long d = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                if (d < minDelta) minDelta = d;
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                if (list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                    long d = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                    if (d < minDelta) minDelta = d;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0) {
            forwardScan(x - 1, y, acc + (!rev ? gainA[x][y] : 0), rev);
        }
        if (y > 0) {
            forwardScan(x, y - 1, acc + (rev ? gainB[x][y] : 0), rev);
        }
    }

    static void backwardScan(int x, int y, long acc, boolean rev) {
        if (x + y == N) {
            ArrayList<long[]> list = rightPaths[x][rev ? 1 : 0];
            long target = (total + 1) / 2 - acc;
            int idx = lowerBound(list, target);
            if (idx < list.size() && list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                long d = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                if (d == minDelta) result += list.get(idx)[1];
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                if (list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                    long d = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + acc) * 2 - total);
                    if (d == minDelta) result += list.get(idx)[1];
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0 && pattern.charAt(x + y - 1) != 'B') {
            backwardScan(x - 1, y, acc + (!rev ? gainA[x][y] : 0), rev);
        }
        if (y > 0 && pattern.charAt(x + y - 1) != 'A') {
            backwardScan(x, y - 1, acc + (rev ? gainB[x][y] : 0), rev);
        }
    }

    static void combine(ArrayList<long[]> v) {
        if (v.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(v, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
        long sum = 0;
        ArrayList<long[]> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); i++) {
            sum += v.get(i)[1];
            if (i + 1 == v.size() || v.get(i)[0] != v.get(i + 1)[0]) {
                tmp.add(new long[]{v.get(i)[0], sum});
                sum = 0;
            }
        }
        v.clear();
        v.addAll(tmp);
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<long[]> list, long target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid)[0] < target) {
                low = mid + 1;
            } else {
                high = mid;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        pattern = br.readLine();

        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }

        N = R + C;
        total = comb[N * 2][R * 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    gainA[i][j] = comb[i - 1][R - 1] * (comb[N * 2 - i][R] - comb[j][R]);
                }
                if (j > 0) {
                    gainB[i][j] = comb[j - 1][R - 1] * (comb[N * 2 - j][R] - comb[i][R]);
                }
            }
        }

        pathCount[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
                if (i < N && pattern.charAt(i + j) != 'B') {
                    pathCount[i + 1][j] += pathCount[i][j];
                }
                if (j < N && pattern.charAt(i + j) != 'A') {
                    pathCount[i][j + 1] += pathCount[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            leftPaths[i] = new ArrayList[2];
            rightPaths[i] = new ArrayList[2];
            for (int d = 0; d < 2; d++) {
                leftPaths[i][d] = new ArrayList<>();
                rightPaths[i][d] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int k = R; k <= N; k++) {
            if (pattern.charAt(k + R - 1) != 'B') {
                buildPaths(R, k, gainA[R][k], comb[k + R - 1][R - 1], pathCount[R - 1][k], false);
            }
            if (pattern.charAt(k + R - 1) != 'A') {
                buildPaths(k, R, gainB[k][R], comb[k + R - 1][R - 1], pathCount[k][R - 1], true);
            }
        }

        for (int i = R; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int d = 0; d < 2; d++) {
                combine(leftPaths[i][d]);
                combine(rightPaths[i][d]);
            }
        }

        minDelta = total + 1;
        result = 0;

        forwardScan(N, N, 0, false);
        forwardScan(N, N, 0, true);
        backwardScan(N, N, 0, false);
        backwardScan(N, N, 0, true);

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
